title: A "Swiftie" Sanctuary - Walk to Broadway + Rooftop
description:
It was all by design…

Welcome to The Lover House, a unique townhome and rooftop with a nod to the mastermind of them all, Taylor Swift. This colorful space is inspired from the home featured in the “Lover” music video! Less than a mile to Broadway, this 4 bed/3.5 bath home is in a topnotch location & offers stunning views of the Nashville Skyline.

For larger groups, message us about renting our other attached units!
